about_item: SOOTHING RELIEF FOR SENSITIVE PET EARS. Acts quickly to alleviate uncomfortable ear issues like itching, swelling, and scratching with Wondercide’s versatile all-in-one ear solution and cleaner. This gentle formulation will eliminate the root of odors and soothe itchiness and painful irritations around the ears and in the ear canals.

THE SCIENCE OF HOCl. Known as Hypochlorus acid, the HOCl molecule is naturally occurring in the body of mammals and it has a safety profile similar to saline. It is formulated such that it does not sting or burn when applied to irritations and it’s safe to use around the eyes, ears and mouth of your dog or cat when used as directed

SUPPORTS DAILY EAR HEALTH. Wondercide RESCUE Ear Drops can be used regularly to cleanse, remove wax build-up, dirt, and other gunk, freshening ears and calming inflammation. Safe for both dogs and cats of all ages, including puppies and seniors, when used as directed.

FLEXIBLE SILICONE APPLICATOR FOR STRESS FREE USE. Designed for pet parents, the soft, flexible dropper makes this powerful anti-itch ear rinse and wash easy to apply with one hand. Precision control gives you accurate dosing, even with wiggly pups or squirmy cats. Just drop, massage, and let the comfort begin!

MADE IN THE USA WITH JUST 3 INGREDIENTS Crafted with purified water, salt, and electricity, Wondercide RESCUE delivers Pure Hypochlorous in its cleanest form produced in a cGMP registered facility. No buffers, no nonsense.

product_details.directions: Shake lightly and carefully dispense 2-3 drops into the ear canal. Gently massage the inside base of the ear for 30 seconds. Allow your pet to shake its head to spread the solution and dislodge any debris. Allow to air dry, no rinsing needed. Reapply twice daily until condition subsides. For maintenance, continue to use daily. Also good to use after bath, swimming, or outdoor activities. If conditions persist, consult your veterinarian. Safe for use around mouth, nose, eyes, and paws.
